task: four stations (BRW, MLO, SMO, SPO), past 14 days -> next 14 days per station, ppm
question: Residual Engression with median alignment feeds one noise vector to all four stations. Does giving every station its own noise vector remove the too-strong dependence between stations without losing anything else?
source_project: 01_实验项目/四站14天_残差Engression_20260923 (windows, frozen-feature caches, native head, NumPy implementation)
joint_metric_source: 01_实验项目/四站14天_Copula_Engression_20260928 (joint metrics code, and the per-window results of its methods for paired comparisons)
implementation: numpy_float64_manual_gradients, the 9/23 code unchanged plus rq/station_noise.py

residual_centered_z1280.role: control: the 9/23 case, one noise vector per trajectory shared by the four stations; must reproduce the 9/23 results exactly

residual_centered_station_z1280.role: the only change: one noise vector per trajectory and station

head: residual_centered: sample = native Q50 + scale * (g([h, eps]) - median over samples of g); point forecast equals native Q50
selection: validation standard ES (lambda=1/2), epoch 0 eligible, improvement threshold 1e-9
pre_declared_supplement: Same rule as 9/23: if a case reaches epoch 80 without triggering patience, it is additionally run with max 300 epochs (everything else identical, validation-only selection) and reported as a separate supplementary row; the 80-epoch rows remain the primary result.
conformal: per_station_per_lead_expansion_only_split_CQR on 2024 (unchanged uq14/conformal.py); interval only, as for every other model of the project
recalibrated_samples: additional evaluation: each cell's samples are mapped by one increasing function so that their Q10..Q90 move onto conformally widened values (2024, four central intervals, thresholds nondecreasing outwards). Ranks inside a cell are unchanged, so the dependence is unchanged. Gives joint metrics after calibration.
metrics: single cell: unchanged uq14/metrics.py evaluate_predictions, before and after conformal. Joint: joint/metrics.py (unchanged copy of the copula project's module)

analysis_plan.fixed_before_test_evaluation: Both cases, all hyperparameters (copied from 9/23), the supplementary rule and the recalibration rule were written here before the per-station case was evaluated on 2025. No hyperparameter is tuned in this experiment.
analysis_plan.primary: per-station noise against the shared-noise control, paired over the 15 test windows: station-difference CRPS and coverage, four-station band coverage, four-station-mean CRPS (expected to improve); cell CRPS, MIS80 after conformal, within-station variogram score, station-mean CRPS (expected not to get worse)
analysis_plan.secondary: against TimesFM marginal + empirical copula (B3) and + static Gaussian copula (B2) of the copula project, before and after calibration

test_status: 2025 has been inspected in earlier experiments; no setting here is chosen from test results
two_station_rerun: two-station rerun 2026-10-01: TimesFM reads only BRW and MLO and the head is trained on them; copied from 01_实验项目/四站14天_残差Engression_分站噪声_20260928, otherwise unchanged
